title: The models for analyzing and evaluating the financial assets 1

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop skills in building, estimating, and testing models for portfolio selection and financial asset pricing.
Apply portfolio theory and capital asset pricing models to analyze and select investment portfolios.
Analyze and manage financial risks using various models and strategies.
Conduct financial analysis using real-world data with software tools like Excel and R.
Understand and apply mathematical concepts to financial asset analysis and valuation.
Apply economic theories to financial asset analysis and valuation.
Estimate and test models using statistical methods.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate financial models and theories.
Work effectively in groups and manage group dynamics.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral formats.
Develop self-learning and independent working skills.
Solve complex financial problems using analytical and quantitative methods.
